name: PBK Brain Grade Readiness
purpose: Runtime truth about whether player/lineup grades are merely implemented, actually populated, proxy-limited, validation-ready, or validated. This registry is research/governance only and never changes betting eligibility, probability, EV, stake, or the forward journal.
global_guardrails: A metric with zero production evidence rows cannot be called operationally ready.
A calculated metric is not validated until predictive value is tested out of sample.
Missing player or lineup evidence remains unknown; never fabricate or backfill it.
No player/lineup research metric may mutate canonical R1/R2/R3 eligibility, stake, probability or the immutable forward journal before explicit validation and project-owner approval.

metrics.reason: PBK Overall Grade implementation exists, but Stage77 has not yet produced player_stats_snapshots/player_grade_snapshots in production.
metrics.next_gate: Capture real prior-match player rows, then test stability/calibration by position and predictive contribution out of sample.

metrics.reason: Rolling Form-5/Form-10 logic exists with no-lookahead, but there are zero production grade rows to roll.
metrics.next_gate: Populate grade history and validate Form-5/Form-10 versus season baseline and future team outcomes without leakage.

metrics.reason: Official/provider-current XI snapshots exist, but current XI-quality rows have zero covered players and blank quality values because player grades are absent.
metrics.next_gate: Obtain player-grade coverage for confirmed/expected XI and validate XI edge/delta prospectively.

metrics.reason: Starts-vs-no-starts research logic with minimum samples and shrinkage exists, but production importance rows are zero.
metrics.next_gate: Accumulate finished fixtures with XI and player evidence, then evaluate stability and confounding before any decision use.

metrics.reason: Rotation snapshots and current-vs-previous XI membership exist; raw turnover can be measured now, but quality-weighted rotation is blocked by player grades.
metrics.next_gate: Validate simple turnover descriptively, then add grade-weighted rotation only after XI Quality has coverage.

metrics.reason: Delta-vs-previous-XI code exists, but current XI Quality values are blank because player grades are absent.
metrics.next_gate: Populate XI grades and test whether quality delta predicts outcomes/markets beyond price and team strength.

metrics.reason: No validated metric yet combines confirmed absence, player importance/grade and replacement quality.
metrics.next_gate: Define no-lookahead absence evidence and replacement-quality contract after stable team identity, roster, lineup and grade coverage exist.

metrics.reason: Key-player return is an intended hypothesis but has no validated metric or sufficient longitudinal player evidence yet.
metrics.next_gate: Define return event from observed absence/presence history without inferred injury dates, then validate prospectively.

metrics.reason: There is no validated composite Team Overall Grade. Team strength, XI quality, availability, form and context must remain separate until their incremental predictive value is measured.
metrics.next_gate: Validate component features first; do not create an arbitrary weighted average.

metrics.reason: No validated style-vs-style matchup grade currently exists.
metrics.next_gate: Build only after event/style data coverage can support explicit matchup features.
